observations: Photo 0 shows a silver and black camera body with "Nikon" on the pentaprism and "Z fc" on the top right; the body cap reads "Nikon Z mount".
Photo 1 shows the top shutter-speed dial, "Nikon" branding, and "Z fc" on the top plate; a lens is mounted with an aperture ring.
Photo 2 shows the complete kit: camera body, a Nikon EN-EL25a battery, a Nikon MH-32 charger, a body cap, a rear lens cap, and a small cap marked "TTArtisan APS-C 35mm F2.0".

claims.evidence: Nikon logo visible on camera body in photos 0 and 1, and on battery and charger in photo 2.
"Z fc" visible on the top right of the camera body in photos 0 and 1.
Sensor specifications cannot be seen in any photo.
Visible retro dials and SLR-style body in all photos.
